Traditional Muesli
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, February 14, 2010 - 4:29am

Ingredients




1 cup muesli cereal
1 apple, chopped or grated
2 tablespoons toasted sunflower seeds
1 orange, Juice of
cup chopped mixed dried fruit
1 cup nonfat fruit flavored yogurt

Preparation

1 Instead of eating doughy pancakes with flavored corn syrup at a truck stop, have a nutritious hearty breakfast. 2 In a medium mixing bowl, combine all ingredients and let stand 5 minutes. 3 Makes 4 servings. Lacto
